title: docs(qa): checklist items for multi-replica on Redis, the recycle bin and record-mode currency since 18.3.0
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBNP69gnL1YUb368kmLct4Bn)_

Fixes #32020

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：给 18.4.0 发布测试台账补上 18.3.0 之后落地的三块能力的测试项：回收站（删除后撤销、恢复、清空、Setup 页面）、多币种记录模式金额（本币预览、Studio 本币字段编辑器、改指向货币字段时的 409 拒绝），以及 Redis 多副本部署的启动拒绝和运行期行为。共新增 16 条，并修正一条发票多币种条目。
- 为什么改：发布前的 `since:v18.4` 测试轮只能测台账里有的东西；这三块能力此前没有任何条目，测试员会漏测。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `docs/qa/platform-checklist/` 下的台账文件，没有产品代码、权限或数据语义变化，可直接 revert。
- 先看：`FOLLOW-UPS.md` 的 §17（范围、哪些条目被阻塞及原因），然后是 `areas/api-backend.json` 末尾两条回收站条目。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`（exit 0）；`node scripts/checklist-select.mjs since:v18.4` 应列出 34 条，其中 10 条来自本 PR（9 条新增、1 条修订），另有 6 条多副本条目因缺少多节点授权门而标为 blocked，加 `--include-blocked` 后为 40 条。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## Premise

The card's premise command at the base (`43a51b55`, history deepened to the 18.3.0 subject):

```
$ git -C . log --oneline 83d7e4ae..origin/main | wc -l
1159
$ git -C . log --oneline 83d7e4ae..origin/main | grep -iE 'replica|recycle|home amount|currency' | wc -l
51
```

Before this PR, the 24 items carrying `since: "v18.4"` were all M1's (themes 1 and 3), so none covered themes 2, 4 or 5. FOLLOW-UPS §17 accounts for all 51 commits: 23 are covered by an item here, 10 are docs, ADR, skills or test commits with no surface, 17 are outside the card's named list, and one (#31848) is a false match ("concurrency" contains "currency").

## Theme 4: the recycle bin (4 items, all active)

- `api-backend.recycle-bin-delete-entry-restore` (P1): the delete answer's `recycleBinEntryId`, the listing (cascade snapshot, deletedBy, 30-day retention, purgeAfter), the restore receipt under the original ids, the second restore's 404, and a `sys_` delete that keeps no entry.
- `api-backend.recycle-bin-refusals-purge-empty` (P1): `RESTORE_PARENT_IN_RECYCLE_BIN` (naming the parent's entry, then restoring once it is restored), `RESTORE_PARENT_PURGED`, purge, empty, the declared paging and parameter refusals, and the non-manager 403s (via `search:qa-contributor-bound-member`) and the anonymous 401.
- `records-forms.delete-toast-undo-restore` (P1): the confirm question without a permanence promise, the toast's Undo restoring through the bin, the list-row Undo, the bulk toast with no Undo, and a platform-object delete that still says it cannot be undone.
- `records-forms.setup-recycle-bin-page` (P2): Setup → Recycle bin's object list, entries table, Restore and Empty with its confirm.
- Not driven live, recorded in knownGaps and FOLLOW-UPS §17b/§17c: `RESTORE_UNIQUE_VALUE_TAKEN` (no showcase business object declares a unique field), `RESTORE_PACKAGE_UNINSTALLED` (destructive to the boot), and the own-entry half of the restore rule (no stock persona holds `allowRestoreOwnDeleted` without `manageRecycleBin`). All three are pinned by tests.

## Theme 5: record-mode currency (3 active, 1 planned, 1 revision)

- `records-forms.home-amount-preview-states` (P2): the preview's converted, home-currency, awaiting-date and awaiting-rate states, and the unreadable-rate message for a member who may not read `sys_exchange_rate`.
- `studio-authoring.currency-home-amount-editor` (P2): which fields each picker offers, the three saved pointers, a record stored through them, and clearing them.
- `studio-authoring.currency-field-repointed-refusal` (P2): the 409 `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` with the `currency_field_repointed` issue, its remedies, `?force=true`, and an identical pointer raising nothing.
- Planned: `records-forms.master-detail-child-follows-parent-currency` (`since: null`). The spec admits the `PARENT_FIELD.CODE_FIELD` path (#31956), but at the base the engine reads `currencyField` as a field of the same row, so a path reads no code. The engine half is #31911 (open). FOLLOW-UPS §17a.
- Revision: `records-forms.multi-currency-invoice` rev 2. `since` goes from `v18` to `v18.4`: the showcase invoice became the multi-currency example in #31757, and the hint and preview that `acceptance[5]` reads landed in #31638 and #31724, all after 18.3.0. Its knownGaps[0] no longer says a child amount cannot take its parent's currency. No clause changed.

## Theme 2: multi-replica on Redis (8 items, all active, 6 blocked)

- Runnable now (both refuse before any gate or Redis is needed):
  - `cli.serve-multi-replica-local-database-refusal` (P1): `os serve` refuses a SQLite or file database under declared replicas on redis, exit 1, naming a shared Postgres, before anything connects.
  - `cli.start-multi-replica-auth-secret-refusal` (P1): `os start` refuses without `OS_AUTH_SECRET` and writes no `auth-secret` file; a memory driver is not the declaration.
- `blocked: { by: "fixture" }`, each stating its two-replica fixture:
  - `attachments-storage.multi-replica-local-root-refusal`;
  - `platform-core.multi-replica-package-change-refusal` (the seven `/packages` doors, install-local both ways, and the clone that would create a customization package);
  - `platform-core.ready-cluster-driver-health`;
  - `platform-core.cluster-membership-heartbeat`;
  - `platform-core.settings-change-reaches-every-replica`;
  - `platform-core.shared-redis-cache-across-replicas`.
- Why they are blocked: the open tree registers no multi-node gate. `checkMultiNodeAllowed` fails closed with none registered, `os serve` falls back to the in-process driver, and the split-brain guard refuses the declared topology, so no declared multi-replica boot on Redis reaches `kernel:ready` on a stock tree. The open-tree route the CLI pin uses (an app whose own `@objectstack/service-cluster` calls `registerMultiNodeGate`, `writeApp` in `serve-multi-node-gate-declaration.integration.test.ts`) is unproven with the real redis driver. The first run that proves it should become an area recipe and lift `blocked` on all six. FOLLOW-UPS §17c.

## What changes

- 16 new items across `api-backend`, `records-forms`, `studio-authoring`, `cli`, `attachments-storage` and `platform-core`, each with `source[]` anchors that resolve and a history row citing #32020. One revision (`records-forms.multi-currency-invoice` rev 2).
- `coverage.json`: the recycle-bin items are mapped to `crud_endpoints` (and the refusals item to `permission`); the currency items to `field`, and the re-point refusal to `object` and `metadata_endpoints`; the invoice item, never mapped before, to `field`. The six blocked theme-2 items are mapped nowhere: an item no run can drive does not carry a kind.
- `FOLLOW-UPS.md` §17: scope and angles, the item list, 17a (planned, carded), 17b (notes for owners), 17c (fixtures worth adding), 17d (security note).

## Why

The 18.4.0 release run selects `since:v18.4`. Before this PR it held nothing for the recycle bin, record-mode currency or multi-replica deployments, which landed after 18.3.0 (epic #32022, M2).

## Tests

No test code changed. Every clause is read from source at `43a51b55` (the merge of `origin/main` at `036a9fbf` was re-checked by the gates below), and each item's `automated.ref` names the pins that hold it today. No live checklist run was made; that is the QA seat's `since:v18.4` run on the release candidate.

## Acceptance notes

- **Read from source, not from titles.** Each assertion was read in the code it cites (routes, refusal sentences, codes, constants). Two first drafts were corrected against the code before commit: a storage settings change to the local adapter under declared replicas is not refused at the settings door but logged and not applied by the subscriber (§17b records this as an owner note), and `/me/permissions` is served at `/api/v1/auth/me/permissions`.
- **Blocked, not faked.** The order allows a multi-replica item without a fixture only as `blocked` with its reason. The six items state the fixture they need and the premise check (`[cluster] multi-node not authorized (` absent from both boot logs) that proves it was met.
- **The doc-formula gate's first run exited 3** (nothing measured: `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` were not built in this fresh container). After `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` it exited 0, and that is the exit recorded below.
- **Shared files with #32233** (open): `api-backend.json`, `platform-core.json` and `records-forms.json`. This PR only appends items at the end of each items array and revises the last item of `records-forms.json`. The seat was told before the push; whichever lands second merges main.
- No changeset: `docs/qa/` only, labelled `skip-changeset`.

## Verification

On head `a4eaf691` (this branch with `origin/main` at `036a9fbf` merged in):

- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` → exit 0 (16 areas, 402 items; coverage 40 kinds mapped, 4 waived; 10/10 recipes referenced, 17 item references resolved; symbol anchors 1397/1407 resolved, the other 10 on the named #16898 residual).
- `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs since:v18.4 --json` → exit 0, 34 runnable items, 10 of them from this PR (9 new, plus the revised invoice item): theme 4 × 4, theme 5 × 4 (3 new and the invoice revision), theme 2 × 2. With `--include-blocked`: 40 (the 6 blocked theme-2 items).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` → 16 commands, each run with its exit recorded: 16 × exit 0 (see the doc-formula note above). `--ran` on that record: `16 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED` (exit 0).
- Diff: 8 files, +1335 / -8 (1,343 changed lines, under 3,000).

## Human Minimum

Each item is one rule from
[CONTRIBUTING.md › Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum),
which links the AGENTS.md text that states it.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (`packages/**` is untouched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No lintable source changed: JSON and Markdown under `docs/qa/` only.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (Nothing publishes; labelled `skip-changeset`.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [ ] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (All but the `## 维护者速读` block, which the order asks for in Chinese.)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
